documented_point_masses: step_abs_hi.mean_firing_rate_Hz: only 4 distinct values over 512 finite rows -- expected: Hay L5b PC fires 14-18 Hz at its 1.1 nA step, i.e. 6-7 spikes in the 400 ms window, and E6's clustered prior concentrates the draws further; few distinct counts is the readout's resolution at this rate, not a point mass in the model
